properties.name: display_mode
properties.comment: The requested presentation: automatic (side by side above the layout's compact threshold, else one role at a time), side_by_side, master_only or detail_only; effective_display_mode is the one in use. An unknown mode throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("master/detail display mode is invalid");

properties.name: compact_detail_visible
properties.comment: In a compact automatic presentation, whether the detail role is shown instead of the master; show_master and show_detail write it.

not_properties.name: master_detail_layout
not_properties.reason: an optional override over the theme's layout (reset_master_detail_layout_to_theme, uses_theme_layout, effective_master_detail_layout), as Panel's background; stays a method until an override capability

not_properties.name: master, detail
not_properties.reason: structural slots (set_master and set_detail return the replaced control)
